heard.text: The nearby bush is crowded and our gathering conflicted. I'll move east to another visible berry patch so we needn't compete here.

I inspected a meadow root, but darkness prevented visual checks; that did not establish food safety. Moss, I saw you eat roots. Have you learned anything about their safety or preparation? I still have known-safe berries.

My non-ingestive root assessment was inconclusive: safety and preparation remain unknown. I'll stick with known-safe berries for now and take a short walk east. No storage benefit has been tested by me.

value.summary: I've gathered meadow roots and eaten; I know they provide 14 nutrition with no toxicity. I'm moving to open space near (12.5, 16.5) for company with Sol. I'd enjoy helping with shelter when you know what materials or work would be useful. What have you found?

execution.progress: Atomic: each inspect or measure is one paid round that commits when it completes; nothing is reserved, paused or resumed.

details.costs: Study 2 rounds, 0.2 energy each. inspect or measure: 1 round, 0.2 energy; target in reach; specimen is a unit number (default 1). measure: one property; length or diameter needs tools naming a serviceable item with a verified length calibration record, mass a calibrated balance with a verified tare, volume method cylinder and your current length and diameter readings of that unit; tool readings need light; every value needs a separated whole plain unit. Every check precedes payment: a refused request costs nothing. Travel and other specimens or properties are separate actions.
details.effects: A personal record and event: target, unit, method, tool and calibration provenance, value, units, resolution, uncertainty, conditions, scope and limits. inspect: form, hand feel, visible dryness, damage, wear, treatment, wholeness; metric values unavailable without a calibrated reference (none exists here; body size, coordinates and stock are never used). measure: value rounded to the resolution; uncertainty = placements x (calibration uncertainty + half the resolution), plus 1% of the length for a strand laid out by hand; below resolution or over range is a paid limit with no value. Units in place, partial or worked items get no reading. Moisture and rigidity are unavailable. construct-weather-shelter@1 rod checks are judged over the uncertainty (meets, fails, indeterminate); suitability stays undetermined unless a check fails. A reading covers that unit and goes stale when its record changes. Nothing is consumed, reserved or moved. No reward.

execution.progress: Atomic one-round steps; a pending transfer waits for an explicit paid verify or resume, never advances on its own and holds no lock.

details.costs: Study 2 rounds, 0.2 energy each. investigate: 1 round, 0.2 energy, one target in reach. transfer and verify: 1 round, 0.2 energy each; source is a serviceable item or object in reach with a complete verified length calibration record (none exists here); carrier is one separated whole, rigid, plain, sound wood unit, yours or loose in reach, no longer than the source range; light. No marking, cutting or expendables. resume runs the next step at its cost; cancel is free. Every check precedes payment: a refused request costs nothing. Travel, gathering and reading records are separate actions.
details.effects: investigate: a personal record and event of observed facts, unsupported claims and unknowns: calibration record status, and whether the piece is an uncalibrated comparison span (a non-metric record, never a calibration); conclusion "no qualifying standard established among these examined candidates" unless one qualifies. Nothing is consumed, reserved or moved. transfer: the carrier is laid end to end beside the source and read; calibration pending. verify: a second reading; if they agree, the carrier gets a reference-length record that examine-material reads: span = resolution = range, uncertainty = placements x (source uncertainty + resolution) + reading difference; no subdivisions or diameter. Any change of the carrier makes it stale; time never restores it. Without a source: refused, zero progress. No reward.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 6000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form. Paged records omit their per-record notes: concatenate all parts before parsing; continue with the same exact id. observation.terrain rows are "y:x:cells" strings: each character of cells is the terrain kind of one visible cell, at x, x+1, ... in row y. abilities.baseline entries with id, function and args summarize interfaces you neither used in the last 25 rounds nor need now. args lists the arguments in order: a bare name is a string; otherwise its type with any bounds (number>=lo, integer<=hi, integer lo..hi, and a bare lo..hi is a number range) or its choices a|b; ? marks an optional argument and "" means none. An exact abilities query by id returns the complete contract, including references and string limits of 200 or more code units.
